checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are square and span 5 s; the audio track can't be checked, but the clip was requested silent.
Same robot, pot and plant, and the first and last frames match the original closely.

must.item: Yellow body, single eye, purple boots consistent
must.why: Yellow body, one big eye and purple boots stay consistent in all frames. A small pocket detail appears on the torso mid-clip.

must.item: Can visibly tips and water flows onto seedlings
must.why: At 2 s and 3.5 s the can tips and a blue water stream pours onto the plant and pot. The water looks somewhat solid and sits near the leaves rather than clearly falling from the spout.
The flat, outlined cartoon style stays the same in every frame.

faults.what: Water looks like a solid blob or sheet and starts oddly at the spout. The can is held near the face, and its lid and handle are slightly morphed.
A pocket or panel appears on the torso mid-clip and the arm and hand shapes shift slightly.
Slight softness or compression in the video frames compared with the still image.

summary: The clip keeps the same cartoon robot and style, tips the red can and shows water pouring onto the seedlings, with only minor artefacts in the water and torso details.
